title: LLM Response v1
description: A closed provider-agnostic terminal response envelope for one bounded language-model completion. Failed provider invocations and successful provider roundtrips are counted separately, and diagnostics remain bounded and sanitized.

schema.description: The versioned identifier for this normalized LLM response contract.

status.description: Terminal outcome of request validation, provider execution, output validation, or bounded retry processing.

oneOf.description: Validated structured output returned after applying outputSchema.
Unstructured text output returned when outputSchema was not configured.

examples.value: The work item is ready for decomposition.

oneOf.description: No output is available because request, configuration, provider, or bounded-attempt processing terminated before a usable completion was returned.

output.description: Typed completion output on success, raw text when no output schema was configured, or null for terminal failures.

examples.value: The work item is ready for decomposition.

failedAttempts.description: Count of provider invocations that failed before returning a usable provider response. Provider failures increment this counter without incrementing iterations; pre-provider failures leave both counters at zero.

iterations.description: Count of successful provider roundtrips, including responses later rejected by output-schema validation and correction responses. This value does not repeat the request's maxIterations limit.

errors.description: Bounded sanitized diagnostics. Entries exclude credentials, authorization headers, unbounded prompts, raw provider responses, and other secret or unbounded content.

examples.message: Provider output did not satisfy the configured output schema.
The provider request failed before a usable response was returned.

SchemaMetadata.description: Identity metadata for the output schema used to validate structured output.

name.description: Configured output schema name or identifier.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path from which the configured output schema was resolved.

StructuredOutput.description: Validated structured completion output produced when an output schema is configured.

oneOf.description: Absolute schema URI identifying the configured output schema.
Schema identity and optional source path used to validate value.

schema.description: Configured schema identity and optional source path used to validate value.

value.description: Parsed JSON value that passed validation against the configured output schema.

^\\$type$.description: Effective JSON type of the parsed structured output value.

RawOutput.description: Unstructured text completion output produced when no output schema is configured.

oneOf.description: Null because no output schema was configured for raw text output.
Absolute schema URI retained as metadata for the raw response.

schema.description: Null because no output schema was configured for raw text output, or an absolute schema URI retained as metadata.

value.description: Raw provider response text returned without JSON parsing or structured-output validation.
examples: The work item is ready for decomposition.

^\\$type$.description: Fixed effective JSON type for raw text output.

examples.value: The work item is ready for decomposition.

Error.description: One bounded and sanitized diagnostic describing a terminal or recoverable completion failure.

code.description: Stable sanitized error classification used by callers without exposing provider internals or secrets.

message.description: Bounded human-readable explanation that excludes credentials, authorization headers, raw provider output, and unbounded prompt content.

phase.description: Bounded processing phase in which the diagnostic was produced.
